rules.statement: A gift by a Buddhist priest to his pupil and the latter's successors in pupillary succession does not necessarily create a charitable trust for the benefit of the temple, unless the deed clearly indicates such an intention.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems a novel and a bold view to take, that where the beneficiaries of a trust are Buddhist priests, the trust is charitable. The learned Judge answered issue (4) in the affirmative in this view of the matter, but he goes on in his judgement to say: 'Though it is not stated in so many words in the deed itself, there is no doubt that the intention of the donor was that the gift was for the benefit of the Temple'."
